findings.description: The new multipass guard pairs separate style and PrePaint arrays using only non-strict timestamp comparisons. Two identical style records and two identical PrePaint records, all complete X with dur:0 and ts=1020100 after the final marker, pass equal cardinality, parent containment and every <= ordering check; they are then reported as two passes with a terminal pass. No distinct occurrence or interleaving is established. Reversing the tied PrePaint/style event order also passes because the arrays discard cross-kind order.
